name: Visually floating circular plinth

original_specification.name: Visually floating circular plinth
original_specification.description: Visually floating circular plinth is a conceptual setting for single consumer-product presentation. It combines the specified surroundings with independently managed lighting.
original_specification.geometry: Solid disk on a recessed support; floating appearance comes from geometry
original_specification.ambient_lighting: Neutral studio ambience with space for a separate rim light
original_specification.scale_policy: Disk diameter from 0.1 to 3 m; base fitted to the object; preserve subject dimensions; fit the stage once to an explicit selection, never continuously rescale the CAD model
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural geometry; externally supplied textures require asset-level license verification
validation: Check physical support and product scale.
Ensure platforms do not hide functional parts; inspect self-shadowing and reflections.

geometry_summary.units: millimetres Z-up in OBJ; metres Y-up in glTF/GLB

radiance.source_owner: HDR owns distant room/task patches; the separate Sun owns solar energy

background.limitations: Not a photograph or native renderer output; finite scene geometry is provided separately.

limitations: Round staging is a faceted ellipsoid realization, not an exact cylindrical manufacturing solid.
Procedural family realization with named contextual components; no claim that every physical detail of the concept has been modeled or validated.
Native glTF import retains geometry and scalar appearances, not arbitrary material extensions or textures.
